# Restore Mermaid unit spec in test/playwright/unit/code/LivePreview.spec.mjs

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

Design authority: commit `e17fc1d4c2` (#8755 / PR #20337), which shipped the 8-case `Neo.code.LivePreview` unit suite (seven Mermaid cases and one JavaScript dispatch control) on `dev`, and `src/code/LivePreview.mjs` (unchanged on `dev`).

## Context

PR #21365 (`Resolves #21351`) temporarily added `sideBySide` and `editorConfig` unit cases to `test/playwright/unit/code/LivePreview.spec.mjs`. When commit `814692033c` retired `sideBySide` on `19 Nov` to keep tabbed `LivePreview` presentation on the home page, `src/code/LivePreview.mjs` and `resources/css/src/code/LivePreview.css` returned cleanly to `dev`, while `test/playwright/unit/code/LivePreview.spec.mjs` was deleted (`deleted file mode 100644`) instead of restored to `dev` (`e17fc1d4c2`).

## The Problem

Deleting `test/playwright/unit/code/LivePreview.spec.mjs` drops 152 lines / 8 unit tests covering `Neo.code.LivePreview` Mermaid language dispatch, diagram reuse across edits, Markdown <-> Mermaid renderer switching, pending-import guards on tab leave or destroy, deferred unexposed measurement, and `Markdown#processLivePreviewBlocks` fence extraction and the JavaScript dispatch control (#8755 / PR #20337). CI stayed green on #21365 because deleting the spec file removed the tests while `src/code/LivePreview.mjs` remained untouched.

## The Architectural Reality

`src/code/LivePreview.mjs`, `src/component/wrapper/Mermaid.mjs`, and `src/component/Markdown.mjs` on #21365 equal `dev`. Restoring `test/playwright/unit/code/LivePreview.spec.mjs` from `e17fc1d4c2` reinstates the exact unit coverage with zero runtime change.

## The Fix

Once #21365 merges to `dev`, restore `test/playwright/unit/code/LivePreview.spec.mjs` from commit `e17fc1d4c2` (`git checkout e17fc1d4c2 -- test/playwright/unit/code/LivePreview.spec.mjs`) and verify all 8 unit tests pass.

A disposable checkout at `1e6fb3262d` passed all 8 cases with the exact restored file. For a fresh checkout, run `npm run bundle-marked` before the focused unit command below.

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `test/playwright/unit/code/LivePreview.spec.mjs` is restored to its `e17fc1d4c2` contents on `dev` after PR #21365 merges.
- [ ] `npx playwright test test/playwright/unit/code/LivePreview.spec.mjs -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs` passes all 8 unit cases.

## Out of Scope

Re-introducing `sideBySide` or `editorConfig` on `Neo.code.LivePreview`; modifying `src/code/LivePreview.mjs` or `apps/portal/view/home/*`.

## Avoided Traps

- Running default `npx playwright test` without `-c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs`.
- Opening a PR before #21365 merges (which would conflict on `test/playwright/unit/code/LivePreview.spec.mjs`).
